name: Life chart
author: Sascha Manns
description: Daily mood and functionality tracker after the NIMH Life Chart method, with chart, PDF report, optional daily reminder and crisis resources

barWidget.description: Chart icon in the bar, colored when today's entry is missing or critical. Opens a panel for the daily entry (mood, functionality, sleep, notes), a 30/60/90-day chart, a PDF report for any date range and crisis helplines.
